subject: Re: GlacierPay renewal — bakeoff window & uplift commitment
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@glacierpay.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@glacierpay.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@glacierpay.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: GlacierPay renewal — bakeoff scope and timeline

Sofia,

Thanks again for last week's walkthrough. As we head into the renewal window (expires 2028-04-15), the execs want to validate performance claims with a short bakeoff against two incumbents. Key objectives:
- Verify 99th percentile latency at our 2k TPS baseline.
- Confirm cost per 1M tokens under our expected prefix-cache profile.
- Test graceful fallback across availability zones.

Can Redwood commit to a 10-business-day bakeoff starting no later than 2028-03-12? Procurement is asking for a one-page mutual action plan and a draft SOW for uplifted capacity (+30% baseline). Attaching our bakeoff requirements.

Appreciate a clear statement on: whether Redwood will provide dedicated capacity for the test, what model variants you plan to use, and any test-data limitations.

Samantha
Samantha Lewis
Head of Platform Engineering, GlacierPay
Attachment: GlacierPay_bakeoff_requirements_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

---
On Fri, 2 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0700, sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com wrote:
From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@glacierpay.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GlacierPay renewal — bakeoff scope and timeline

Samantha —

Thanks for the clear objectives and attachment. We can run the 10-business-day bakeoff starting 2028-03-13 (earliest) if we finalize the scope by EOD 2028-03-08. High-level answers:
- Dedicated capacity: yes, we can provision a dedicated Redwood Dedicated pool for the test (N+1 across two AZs).
- Model variants: we suggest rwd-bertx-8q for latency-sensitive flows and rwd-neo-l8 for higher-throughput validation; we will document equivalent logits.
- Test-data: we prefer anonymized production traces; if GlacierPay can share a 48-hour trace subset (PII removed), our ops team will ingest it into a controlled test environment.

I'll loop in Karthik to confirm the capacity sizing and Marissa for commercial alignment on the uplifted commitment.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | www.redwoodinference.com

---
On Mon, 5 Mar 2028 09:27:00 -0700, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com wrote:
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@glacierpay.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GlacierPay renewal — bakeoff scope and timeline

Folks —

I ran a quick capacity sketch based on their 2k TPS baseline and the +30% uplift. Proposed test pool: 8x A100-equivalent nodes (mixed precision), isolated network, default KV cache warm-up of 30 mins. Expected results window:
- 99th pctl latency target: <= 120ms for small prompts (<=64 tokens)
- Token cost delta estimate: approx $0.015/1k tokens for the latency variant; $0.009/1k for the throughput variant (subject to batching config).

Operational asks: GlacierPay to provide masked trace and a short traffic profile doc. We can deliver a mutual action plan and a draft SOW by Tue 03/07. Marissa — I recommend offering a 3-month uplift discount on committed capacity if they sign the Dedicated uplift within 30 days post-bakeoff.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_proposed_capacity_profile_Mar2028.pdf (pdf)

---
On Sun, 11 Mar 2028 16:42:00 -0700, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com wrote:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@glacierpay.com>, sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@glacierpay.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@glacierpay.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Mar 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GlacierPay renewal — bakeoff window & uplift commitment

Samantha / Raj —

Appreciate the urgency. To minimize exec friction and neutralize the bakeoff as a reason to switch, Redwood will do the following if GlacierPay confirms the test by 2028-03-15:

1) Guaranteed test configuration: dedicated 8-node pool as outlined (N+1 across AZs).
2) Pricing guardrail: fixed test-run rate capped at the cost equivalent of $0.010/1k tokens for the throughput path (we will absorb overages during the 10-business-day window).
3) Post-test uplift incentive: a one-time credit equal to 20% of the first 3 months' committed Dedicated spend if GlacierPay signs the uplift within 30 days of test completion.
4) Two-week rollback clause in SOW: if production throughput or latency regresses after migration due to model variant incompatibility, Redwood will provide a staged fall-back plan and operational hours for remediation.

We will produce a one-page mutual action plan and a draft SOW by EOD 2028-03-13. For procurement: please confirm the legal contact who will receive the SOW and any corporate PO requirements.

If GlacierPay wants us to include a simple benchmark script and evaluation dashboard ahead of the start date, we can provide that as part of the test kit.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
---

On Mon, 12 Mar 2028 08:03:00 -0700, Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@glacierpay.com> wrote:
From: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@glacierpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@glacierpay.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@glacierpay.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GlacierPay renewal — bakeoff window & uplift commitment

Marissa,

This is helpful and moves things forward. Procurement confirmed we'll accept the fixed test-run rate for the bakeoff and legal will expect the SOW with the rollback clause. Legal will also want an SLA appendix and an approved SOC2 attestation attached. Please send the draft SOW + MAP and we will route immediately.

I'll have Raj and the procurement team confirm the DocuSign recipient for signatures today.

Samantha

--
